policy: Korean is canonical. English and Simplified Chinese are active display languages. Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) is a display variant of zh-CN: the UI renders the zh-CN pack and assets/js/zh-traditional.js converts the displayed text to Traditional (OpenCC s2t), so it has no separate pack. Official legal, immigration, agency, and document terms must be resolved through data/i18n/official-terms.json when available; unverified official names render Korean.
notes: PR A supports ko, en, and zh-CN first. Older locale codes remain selectable as pending/partial and fall back to Korean until validated packs are added.
